en: Black‑and‑white view of a residential or institutional street corner with a large, multi‑storey villa in the foreground. The building has steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and an arched main entrance reached by a short flight of stairs. Surrounding it are similar early‑20th‑century houses with tiled roofs and stucco façades, as well as trees, garden walls, and a quiet paved street. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image itself.
